page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.8xlarge is a storage and memory-focused instance driven by a 16-core Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, providing 32 virtual CPUs via hyperthreading on KVM hypervisor architecture. The instance includes 256 GB of system RAM, allocating 8 GB of memory per physical core. A key feature of the server is its bundled 7679 GB local SSD storage, eliminating the need for attached network storage for high-throughput disk workloads. Network capability is supported by a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark data highlights a clear tradeoff between single-threaded and multi-threaded performance. Single-core tests, such as stress-ng single-core CPU and gzip single-threaded compression, perform in the bottom 25 percentile. However, multi-core benchmarks show solid mid-range performance, with stress-ng multi-core CPU, Geekbench multi-core (10415.0), and Passmark CPU scores falling in the middle 50 percentile. The system handles memory bandwidth and database operations efficiently, achieving 28 million Redis SET operations per second and a static web serving throughput of 21.38 GB/sec.

From a resource density perspective, bundling 7.68 TB of local SSD storage alongside 256 GB of RAM on 32 vCPUs yields a cost-effective hardware footprint for storage-intensive tasks without requiring separate block storage provision. The combination of large memory capacity, extended AVX-512 instruction set support, and dedicated local storage makes the ecs.i3.8xlarge well suited for relational and NoSQL databases, in-memory caching layers, search indexes, software compilation, and ETL data processing pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.8xlarge is a high-density local storage instance powered by a 16-core Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, yielding 32 virtual cores with hyperthreading on a KVM hypervisor. It comes equipped with 256 GB of memory and a bundled 7679 GB local SSD array alongside 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Synthetic benchmarks indicate weak single-threaded performance in tests such as stress-ng single-core and gzip compression. Conversely, multi-threaded CPU throughput, memory bandwidth, and application-level workloads achieve solid middle-tier performance, demonstrated by 28 million Redis SET operations per second and a 10415 Geekbench multi-core score. Hardware features include AVX-512 instruction support for vectorized computing. By combining massive local SSD capacity with 8 GB of RAM per vCPU, the instance delivers strong resource density for data-intensive applications. It is appropriate for relational databases, Redis caching layers, log analytics, search indexing, and large-scale ETL data processing.
